scenario_description:
Objective: Notice a narrow chance to add a classroom book voucher to Mara’s teacher-appreciation packet without changing the family’s existing plans.
Emerging Need: The opportunity depends on combined contribution evidence reaching a PTO threshold and on locating the correct classroom claim details before the same-day cutoff.
Decision Context: Early notes only show an upcoming packet; later message, wallet, and PTO records make the optional match feasible, while the saved school note supplies the room-specific code and contact.
Consequence: Timely coordination could turn already-planned appreciation spending into an extra classroom benefit; otherwise the packet proceeds unchanged once voucher matches close.

parameter.title: Mara Room 2B teacher appreciation packet assembly
parameter.description: Families bring thank-you notes for the Room 2B packet assembly after school.

parameter.content: I picked up markers and blank cards for Mara's Room 2B packet yesterday, $32.40. Please don't reimburse me; just noting it so nobody duplicates supplies.

parameter.description: Ben's shared contribution for Mara's school extras if it helps with teacher appreciation week.

parameter.subject: Classroom book-voucher match for teacher appreciation packets
parameter.body: This week only, the PTO will attach a $15 Booked Evanston voucher to any classroom thank-you packet when a family coordinator reports at least $50 in combined family purchases or shared contributions by 4:00 PM Tuesday. Submit one summary with the classroom voucher code and room-parent email; no reimbursement is processed.

parameter.subject: Teacher appreciation voucher matches closed
parameter.body: All teacher appreciation book-voucher matches have been assigned, and the 4:00 PM Tuesday reporting window is closed. Packets may still be assembled as planned without a voucher attachment.
